concepts.name: Consultation Session Lifecycle
concepts.summary: UserService owns the consultation lifecycle: registration of new users/askers, handling and creation of enquiries, creation of sessions with their chat group(s), and assignment of consultants to sessions.

concepts.name: Consultation Modes
concepts.summary: Four kinds of consultations are handled: single/direct 1:1 counseling, team counseling, group chat counseling, and anonymous counseling (no registration required).

concepts.name: Matrix-backed Messaging
concepts.summary: Real-time messaging runs on Matrix: MatrixMessageController and MatrixSyncController bridge sessions to Matrix rooms (the platform's migration away from the legacy Rocket.Chat group model).

concepts.name: User & Consultant Administration
concepts.summary: Admin-facing account management: UserAdminController with ConsultantAdminFacade and AskerUserAdminFacade cover consultant/asker administration, agency assignment, and account state.

concepts.name: Case Handover
concepts.summary: CaseHandoverController implements transferring cases between consultants/agencies, governed by reason policies.

concepts.name: Invite Links & Account Invitations
concepts.summary: AgencyInviteLinkController and AccountInviteController implement invitation-based onboarding (agency invite links, account invites).

concepts.name: Live Availability & Event Notifications
concepts.summary: ConsultantLiveAvailabilityController and TopicConsultantAvailabilityController expose consultant availability; LiveProxyController and EventNotificationController push live events and notifications to clients.

concepts.name: Statistics & Audit Logs
concepts.summary: AdminStatisticsController and UserStatisticsController expose usage statistics; InactiveAccountAuditLogsController and SupervisorLogsController provide audit trails.

flows.name: Enquiry → Session → Consultant Assignment
flows.summary: An asker registers → creates an enquiry → a session with its chat group is created → a consultant (or team) is assigned and the conversation begins.

flows.name: Matrix Message Roundtrip
flows.summary: Client sends via MatrixMessageController → message lands in the session's Matrix room → MatrixSyncController keeps session state and read models in sync.
